thread:
Jordan (CSM): CedarBridge week0 sync. Main asks: network egress, cross-account IAM, KMS access for model keys, and audit log retention/forwarding. Any blockers?

Priya (CS Ops): Peering and subnets done. Customer reported our SDK failing on initial handshake when routed through their firewall. They requested the exact egress FQDN/IP list.

Alex (NetEng): Shared minimal set in the runbook: api.redwood-inference.com (A: 3.122.11.7, 3.122.11.8), telemetry S3 endpoints for region eu-west-1, and our relay proxy ip 34.201.100.5. Recommend NAT for ephemeral egress and ensure SNAT preserves source.

Mei (Observability): Audit-forwarding: their Splunk HEC requires cert CN match; current cert CN is splunk.internal which fails. They plan cert rotation tonight. Also they asked about immutable retention for 2 years (720d).

Sam (Security): IAM: they had AssumeRole failing because ExternalId missing. I posted the exact trust policy snippet in the runbook. KMS: we see kms:Decrypt denied — their CMK key policy doesn't include our cross-account role. Need kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext allowed for arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-inference.

Priya (CS Ops): Runbook path /runbooks/cedarbridge/week0 updated with: Firewall -> IPs/FQDNs, IAM -> trust policy example, KMS -> key policy snippet, Audit -> HEC steps + S3 fallback.

Jordan (CSM): Excellent. OpsBot, quick scans please.

OpsBot: Automated checks: connectivity=partial (handshake failures), iam=failed (ExternalId missing), kms=failed (AccessDenied), audit-forwarding=failed (cert CN mismatch). Tickets: CS-9901 (IAM), CS-9902 (KMS), CS-9903 (HEC cert).

Alex (NetEng): Temporary workaround: they can add host entries to their NAT instances for api.redwood-inference.com to avoid DNS via TGW. Not ideal long term but will unblock tests.

Sam (Security): I'll DM the KMS key policy snippet to their security lead and request a timestamped confirmation once applied. Also flagged retention change as renewal risk: extending to 720d requires billing amendment.

Mei (Observability): If HEC still fails after cert rotation, we can send encrypted batches to a presigned S3 bucket with SSE-KMS using their CMK. Added that fallback to runbook.

Priya (CS Ops): Action owners: Priya -> DM snippets + confirm applied (owner: Priya). Alex -> follow up on NAT/host entry workaround (owner: Alex). Sam -> escalate KMS policy and retention billing (owner: Sam). Mei -> coordinate HEC validation window (owner: Mei). Jordan -> schedule Thursday cutover validation call 14:00 UTC.

Priya (CS Ops): Snippets sent. Customer acknowledged IAM patch will be applied within 3 hours.

Alex (NetEng): Customer applied host entry workaround in staging, handshake now succeeds in test. Requesting apply to prod.

Sam (Security): KMS policy applied by customer; re-run shows kms tests passing. Retention escalation ticket INFRA-4121 opened; cost delta ~+12% for 720d immutable retention.

Mei (Observability): Cert rotation completed, HEC accepted test event. Final end-to-end test scheduled during Thursday call.

Jordan (CSM): Status: network=amber->green pending prod NAT change, iam=green, kms=green, audit-forwarding=green. Renewal-watch: retention increase may require contract amendment (CS-9940). Closing week0 triage; will post cutover verification after Thursday call.

Priya (CS Ops): :thumbsup:

Alex (NetEng): Tracking prod changes with customer.
